title: Your First Gate
blurb: A rift in the world with a floor to clear and a Lord at the end.

steps.hint: Defeat everything on it, then step to the shrine.

steps.text: Clear a whole gate and take its Lord.
steps.hint: Take what you can carry out. Dying in a gate loses the Satchel.
A twist changes the rules of one gate.

steps.text: Clear a gate without being hit.
steps.hint: It is hard, and it pays.
